name: movie_betelgeuse_isi
label: Movie: Betelgeuse's |V|^2(B) fully measured with the ISI pair at 1550 nm, one baseline per night from 3 to 40 m
notes: The 'fully measure g2' movie: the trucks step the East-West baseline 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 16, 25, 40 m on eight nights, so the measurements walk from |V|^2 ~ 1 through the 9.3 m first null into the sidelobes (log scale), and the joint fit of the diameter and the linear limb-darkening coefficient converges night by night.
Dead-time cap: Betelgeuse's 1550 nm rate is attenuated x0.01 to 2.5e5 cps, so sigma(|V|^2) ~ 0.2 per 5-min block; the per-night precision is set by the ID230, not the star.
